CD_STREAM_PORT.description: UDP discovery and TCP CD subscription port.

CD_STREAM_DISCOVER.description: UDP query for discoverable Stroom CD sources.

CD_STREAM_TRACE.description: Read-only UDP query for the last outgoing TCP stall snapshot.

CD_STREAM_REQUEST.description: TCP subscription request sent before receiving records.

CD_STREAM_MAGIC.description: Four-byte prefix of every TCP record.

CD_STREAM_HEADER_BYTES.description: Record header: magic, big-endian type, big-endian payload byte count.

CD_STREAM_PCM.description: Interleaved signed little-endian stereo PCM16 record.

CD_STREAM_FORMAT.description: First record: three big-endian uint32 values for rate, channels and bits.

CD_STREAM_END.description: Empty record marking a normal end after all preceding PCM.

CD_STREAM_BITS.description: CD network audio bits per sample.

CD_STREAM_MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES.description: Maximum PCM payload: one resampled CD sector at 48 kHz.

CD_STREAM_FORMAT_BYTES.description: Format payload size: rate, channel count and sample bits as three big-endian uint32 values.
